Land status announcement source reconstruction, Linux 53.16

Image: data/runtime/native-elf-images.json reference dwarfort
Identity: ELF:bcc6789e6fb477b785a2b02be80b8b1b054ff88c
Actual Ghidra C: elf-land-elevation-producer.c, elf-site-native-name.c,
elf-site-english-name.c, elf-native-word.c. Complete unwind bodies, call operands, conditional
edges and text operands are retained alongside them. The text below names
the fields recovered from those bodies; it is not replacement decompiler output.

Producer 12c3370..12c58cf processes queued entity changes. Only outer kind 0,
subtype 3 or 4, submits the pictured land-status prose. Other outer kinds and
subtypes update appointments/history/entity state without this announcement.

Subtype 3: LAND_GAINS_STATUS (254)
  12c4380..12c43bf initializes "an official land of the realm" from inline
  and vector stores. It is not a contiguous C string in the image.
  Resolve the entity, queued position IDs, historical figures and live units.
  On the qualifying unit branch (b232b0), a nonempty position.land_name
  (position+258, length +260) replaces the fallback at 12c5142.
  Missing entity/position/figure/unit, failed qualification, or empty LAND_NAME
  leaves the current wording intact. Repeated qualifying positions replace it
  in native iteration order; they do not append an additional sentence.
  Look up plotinfo.site_id (297e2a4) in world_data.sites (world_data+198/+1a0).
  If the site is absent, emit nothing.
  Announcement flags at 26bbd08: mode 0 requires mask 70, other modes mask 8.
  Disabled flags emit nothing; they do not select another text.
  12c46dc calls NativeName(site, output), 12c46ec appends the fixed clause
  and selected land string, then appends a period.
  12c47fa submits type fe, foreground 5 (magenta), duration 2000.

Subtype 4: LAND_ELEVATED_STATUS (255)
  12c3a0b..12c3a8f initializes
  "an even more official land of the realm" from inline/vector stores.
  Resolve the site's entity link and existing position assignment; follow its
  replacement position ID (+2d4). Find the matching assignment and substitute
  nonempty replacement position.land_name at 12c53cc. Failed lookups or empty
  LAND_NAME retain the default. Remaining branches update position ownership,
  figures and unit state, without changing the announcement's sentence shape.
  The same site lookup is required. Flags at 26bbd0c use the same mode masks.
  12c48fa calls NativeName(site, output), 12c490a appends the same fixed clause.
  12c4a18 submits type ff, foreground 5, duration 2000.

Complete visible production, both types:
  NativeName(site) + " and the surrounding lands have been made " + LAND + "."

The currently installed vanilla RAW provides exactly these nonempty LAND_NAMEs:
  MOUNTAIN/BARON: a barony -> 男爵领
  MOUNTAIN/COUNT: a county -> 伯爵领
  MOUNTAIN/DUKE:  a duchy  -> 公爵领
See raw-land-names.tsv for the source positions. LAND_NAME is loaded data,
not an enum of these three strings: custom RAW can provide other titles.
The two native defaults plus these three RAW values give five vanilla text
forms. Each can also have an empty NativeName, giving ten whole-record rules.
The two additional generic rules retain the typed site/LAND_NAME separation
and use existing term translation for additional RAW definitions.

NativeName, 12bfe90..12c0b46:
  has_name at +72 is false -> return without appending a name.
  first_name (+0/+8) may itself be empty.
  nickname (+20/+28) is authored text between backtick/apostrophe; its mode
  can replace the first name, follow it, or hide the nickname.
  WORD groups (+40..+58) use 1cc6140 with the selected language at +6c;
  absent groups are skipped, present groups are capitalized and space-joined.
  None of these paths requires a nonempty final result. The producer still
  appends the full fixed clause when the result is empty.
  This call is NativeName, not EnglishName (12c58d0). The latter body is
  retained to distinguish the site's native spelling from its English alias.

Native WORD supplier, 1cc6140..1cc623a:
  Negative/out-of-range WORD IDs or language IDs return without appending.
  Otherwise append the selected language table's string for that WORD.
  A zero-length entry adds no text. There is no additional fallback label
  or announcement sentence in this function. The strings are RAW language
  data, so arbitrary generated site spellings are resolved by identity,
  not enumerated from this one screenshot.

The runtime rules therefore use $native-site-name, which already resolves
real site identities and their naming preferences, rather than the former
generic entity/name capture. Empty-site productions handle the remaining
clause explicitly. No screenshot-specific spelling or squad alias is added.
The land names here denote territories; fortress/status.toml uses those same
RAW strings as title-column labels, so that unrelated context is unchanged.

Runtime entries are in announcement-status-grammar.tsv and directly in
translations.tsv. Both alert flyouts and expanded/history reports enter the
existing complete announcement grammar. No generated binary is needed.
